subject: Request to reinstate expired pilot credits for procurement gap
messages:
From: Alex Torres <alex@luminahealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot credits expired — can we get a short reinstatement?

Hi Mina,

Quick note from the Lumina team — our sandbox pilot ran out of credits last week (we were on the promo bundle). We were about to sign the PO, but procurement had a delay and the vendor checks pushed us past the expiration date. The team relies on the sandbox to validate integration for our Q4 feature.

Is there any chance you can reinstate some of the lapsed credits for 2–3 weeks while we finalize procurement? If possible, we'd like to preserve the current environment (KV caches, deployed test prompts). I've attached a short usage snapshot that shows where the tokens went.

Appreciate any help — we want to keep momentum.

Thanks,
Alex Torres
Senior Product Manager
LuminaHealth
attachments: trial-usage-snapshot.csv (CSV, 45KB)
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Alex Torres <alex@luminahealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot credits expired — can we get a short reinstatement?

Hi Alex — thanks for the note and the usage file. Sorry to hear you hit the procurement delay. We can usually do a short, conditional reinstatement while procurement completes.

Couple quick clarifying Qs so I can route for approval:
- How many total tokens would get you through the testing window (rough estimate)?
- Do you have a PO date we can expect (or a procurement contact I can nudge)?

Proposed interim option I can request: 350k token top-up valid for 30 days, with the requirement that procurement either signs the PO or provides a formal purchase commitment within that 30 days. If procurement needs more time we can discuss a bridge arrangement with a sales credit hold.

Looping in Ben (cc) for approval on the credit size. If you're comfortable with the 30-day window, reply here with the rough token ask and the PO timeline and I'll push this internally.

—Mina
Mina Haddad
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 09:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: LuminaHealth — request to reinstate expired pilot credits (350k for 30d)

Ben / Steph — quick escalation. LuminaHealth (contact: Alex Torres) hit a procurement timing gap; they asked for a 30-day reinstatement to finish validation. I proposed 350k tokens for 30 days conditional on their PO arriving in that window. Attached usage snapshot indicates they were actively using the sandbox and are close to signing (HubSpot deal RDW-DEAL-7831).

Why I recommend this: keeping the sandbox active preserves momentum and reduces risk of the deal slipping. The requested size (350k) is within our usual bridge concessions for mid-market pilots; we can require procurement commitment and set the credit to expire automatically.

Potential downside: token subsidy cost — estimated at ~ $1,600 in unit costs if they fully consume it. We can treat this as a one-time credit against the MRC if they sign within 60 days.

Can we get approval to provision the 350k token credit as a temporary credit? If approved, I will send official terms and the promo PDF to Alex and finance will track the usage.

Attached: trial-usage-snapshot.csv
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: LuminaHealth — request to reinstate expired pilot credits (350k for 30d)

Mina / Steph — approved. Greenlight 350k tokens, 30-day validity, conditional on PO or signed term sheet within the window. Please include the following in the terms: automatic expiration, no auto-renew, usage reports to be sent to finance if consumption exceeds 80%. Mark the credit as "bridge" on the deal so we can reconcile when the PO lands.

Cc finance and legal if they need to prepare a short order form.

Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Mid-Market Sales Operations
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Alex Torres <alex@luminahealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, procurement@luminahealth.com
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot credits expired — can we get a short reinstatement?

Hi Alex — good news: we can reinstate a temporary credit to keep your sandbox live while procurement completes. Per internal approval, Redwood will provision a one-time 350,000 token credit valid for 30 days from the activation date. Terms:

- Credit amount: 350,000 tokens (one-time)
- Validity: 30 days from activation (auto-expire)
- Condition: PO or signed term sheet expected within the 30-day window; please add procurement@luminahealth.com to the reply so we have the contact.
- Monitoring: If consumption reaches 80% before PO, finance will triage and I'll reach out with options.

I've attached a short terms PDF for your records (promo-terms-LuminaHealth-30d.pdf). Once you confirm the PO ETA I will request finance to activate the credit and preserve your test environment state.

Next steps for you: reply with an estimated PO date (or a best-effort ETA). If procurement prefers, I can also coordinate a brief call with our solutions engineer to ensure the environment is preserved.

Glad we could work through this — pleased to keep momentum on the integration.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198
